data.title: Initial Level Placement
data.description: A high-level scan to establish your current CEFR baseline (A2-B2).

sections.sentence: Choose the correct criticism of a past action.
sections.explain: 'Should have' plus the past participle expresses criticism or regret about a past action.

words.word: You should tell me earlier that the deadline had changed.
You should have told me earlier that the deadline had changed.
You should have tell me earlier that the deadline had changed.

sections.sentence: Choose the correct unreal past condition.
sections.explain: The third conditional uses 'if + past perfect' and 'would have + past participle'.

words.word: If they had checked the figures, they would have noticed the error.
If they checked the figures, they would have noticed the error yesterday.
If they would have checked the figures, they had noticed the error.

sections.sentence: Choose the correct passive reporting structure.
sections.summary: B2 Core: Reporting Verbs in the Passive.
sections.explain: Use 'is believed to have + past participle' to report an earlier event without naming the source.

words.word: The painting believes to have been stolen in 1998.
The painting is believed that it was stolen in 1998.
The painting is believed to have been stolen in 1998.

sections.sentence: Choose the correctly punctuated non-defining relative clause.
sections.explain: A non-defining relative clause adds extra information and is separated by commas.

words.word: My manager, who joined the company last year, is leaving.
My manager who joined the company last year is leaving.
My manager, that joined the company last year, is leaving.

sections.sentence: Choose the sentence that correctly emphasises the reason.
sections.explain: The structure 'What ... was ...' can emphasise the key information in a sentence.

words.word: What caused the delay it was a shortage of staff.
What caused the delay was a shortage of staff.
That caused the delay was a shortage of staff.

sections.sentence: Choose the correct expression of present regret.
sections.summary: B2 Core: Wish and Past Simple.
sections.explain: Use 'wish + past simple' for a present situation that the speaker wants to be different.

words.word: I wish I knew how to solve this problem.
I wish I know how to solve this problem.
I wish I would know how to solve this problem.

sections.sentence: Choose the correctly reduced relative clause.
sections.explain: A present participle can replace an active relative clause: 'employees who work' becomes 'employees working'.

words.word: Employees worked remotely must attend the online meeting.
Employees are working remotely must attend the online meeting.
Employees working remotely must attend the online meeting.

sections.explain: 'Had + subject + past participle' can replace 'If + subject + had + past participle' in formal English.

words.word: Had we known about the closure, we would have taken another route.
Had we knew about the closure, we would take another route.
Would we have known about the closure, we had taken another route.

sections.sentence: Choose the grammatically correct formal recommendation.
sections.explain: After formal verbs such as 'recommend', the that-clause can use the base form: 'that every applicant provide'.

words.word: The committee recommended that every applicant provided two references.
The committee recommended every applicant to provide two references.
The committee recommended that every applicant provide two references.

sections.sentence: Choose the sentence with correct negative inversion and time reference.
sections.explain: When 'Only after' begins the sentence, the main clause is inverted. The earlier completed action uses the past perfect.

words.word: Only after the report had been published did the researchers discover the error.
Only after the report was published the researchers had discovered the error.
Only after had the report been published did the researchers discovered the error.
